original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚矿业执法队否认参与尼日尔州致人死亡行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚安全和民防部队（NSCDC）下属矿业执法队否认参与9月16日在尼日尔州明纳M.I. Wushishi住宅区导致人员死亡的一次行动。矿业执法队指挥官John Onoja Attah称，被停职的尼日尔州指挥官Suberu Siyaka Aniviye关于其部署矿业执法队人员的说法是虚假和误导性的。事件正由Justice Mohammed Mohammed调查委员会调查中。

location.raw_text: M.I. Wushishi Housing Estate in Minna, Niger State

key_facts.fact: 矿业执法队否认参与9月16日在明纳导致人员死亡的行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps Mining Marshals have denied involvement in the September 16 operation at M.I. Wushishi Housing Estate in Minna, Niger State, where deaths occurred

key_facts.fact: 矿业执法队指挥官称被停职的州指挥官无权部署其人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: insisting that the suspended state commandant lacked the authority to deploy its operatives

key_facts.fact: 被停职的尼日尔州指挥官被指声称曾部署矿业执法队人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: claims attributed to the suspended Niger State Commandant of the NSCDC, Suberu Siyaka Aniviye, that he deployed Mining Marshals personnel to the area

key_facts.fact: 事件正由调查委员会调查中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The controversy comes amid an ongoing investigation by the Justice Mohammed Mohammed Commission of Inquiry

uncertainties: 行动中死亡的具体情况和责任归属尚未查明
被停职指挥官的部署说法与矿业执法队的否认存在冲突
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
